display_long_description:
**🐙What would you do if you woke up one day and you were an Octopus🐙** 

Even worse, being held captive by the evil Dr Docto who is back on his evil ways...and wait, is he using you as a test subject?
[media]
It is up to you to sling, leap, climb, stick, battle, eat and camouflage your way through various experiments that Dr Docto has in store for you as you try to escape his clutches to become stronger...so much stronger...
[media]
# 🦍 Fluid Hand-Based Locomotion 🐙
Glide effortlessly through tanks and across the laboratory floor with intuitive, hand-based movement, offering an unparalleled sense of freedom as you manoeuvre around tricky puzzles and outwit Dr Docto.
[media]
# 🏆Creative Problem-Solving and Exploration🧩
Face puzzles and obstacles designed to encourage experimentation. Use your octopus abilities to find inventive solutions, outwitting Dr Docto and proving your worth
[media]
